description: This file implements command-line utilities for interacting with an OVSDB database via JSON-RPC, including functions for select, insert, update, delete, wait, and upsert operations, as well as JSON parsing, formatting, and connection handling.

methods.name: ovsdb_select
methods.description: Performs a select operation on the OVSDB and retrieves results.

methods.name: ovsh_select
methods.description: Wrapper for ovsdb_select that also displays the result.

methods.name: ovsh_mutate
methods.description: Performs a mutate operation on the OVSDB.

methods.name: ovsh_insert
methods.description: Inserts a new row into the specified table.

methods.name: ovsh_update
methods.description: Updates existing rows in the table.

methods.name: ovsh_upsert
methods.description: Performs an upsert (update or insert) operation.

methods.name: ovsh_wait
methods.description: Performs a wait operation on the table rows.

methods.name: ovsdb_json_exec
methods.description: Executes a JSON-RPC command on the OVSDB.

methods.name: ovsdb_json_show_result
methods.description: Displays the result of a select operation in various formats.

methods.name: ovsdb_json_show_result_output
methods.description: Displays result using custom printf format.

methods.name: ovsdb_json_show_count
methods.description: Displays the count of affected rows.

methods.name: ovsdb_json_show_uuid
methods.description: Displays the UUID of inserted row.
